items.title: Medical physics: ta'aruf aur istemal hone wali shuaein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter 20 opening text and the radiations used in medical physics (PDF 156-157).

blocks.text: Medical physics physics ki woh shakh hai jo physics ke usool aur tareeqe ilaj-mualija (medicine) mein, khaas taur par bimariyon ki pehchan (diagnosis) aur ilaj (treatment) mein, istemal karti hai. Yeh physics ke ilm ko medical science se jor kar nayi technologies banati aur chalati hai, jin se doctors insani jism ke andar dekh sakte aur mareezon ka mehfooz aur kamyab ilaj kar sakte hain. Medical imaging ko zyada durust banana, radiation ke khatre kam karna aur ilaj ke tareeqe behtar karna, yeh sab medical physics ka kaam hai. Hospitals aur diagnostic centers mein X-ray imaging, ultrasound scans, CT-scans aur PET-scans isi ki misalein hain; in se doctors bina operation ke haddi ka tootna (fracture) pakarte, rasoli (tumour) ki pehchan karte aur andar ke aza (organs) dekhte hain. Is tarah medical physics jaldi pehchan, achhe ilaj aur behtar zindagi mein madad deti hai. Is chapter mein hum parhenge ke physics ke usoolon se imaging ke jadeed tareeqe kaise bante hain: PET positron–electron annihilation (positron aur electron ka mil kar khatam ho jana) aur gamma-ray detection se kaise kaam karta hai, piezoelectric effect ultrasound waves banane aur pakarne mein kya kaam karta hai, aur X-rays kaise banti aur istemal hoti hain.
Medical physics mein istemal hone wali radiations ka taaruf

Radiation (shua) energy ka khala (space) ya maddah (matter) mein se waves ya particles ki shakal mein guzarna hai. Medical physics mein radiation zyada tar pehchan (imaging) aur ilaj ke liye istemal hoti hai. Radiation ki do bari qismein hain: non-ionizing aur ionizing.

blocks.title: Ionizing radiation
blocks.text: Ionizing radiation mein itni energy hoti hai ke woh atoms se electrons nikal kar ions bana deti hai.

blocks.title: Non-ionizing radiation
blocks.text: Non-ionizing radiation mein atoms se electrons nikalne jitni energy nahi hoti.

Medical physics mein istemal hone wali ionizing radiations ki misalein X-rays, gamma rays aur positrons hain. X-rays aur gamma rays maddah se photoelectric effect aur Compton scattering ke zariye amal (interaction) karti hain. Positrons radioactive tracers (jism mein di jane wali radioactive cheez) se nikalte hain. Doosri taraf non-ionizing radiations ki misalein ultrasound waves aur radiowaves hain; maddah se milne par yeh reflect (palatna), refract (mur jana) ya absorb (jazb) hoti hain.

Gamma rays, X-rays, ultrasonic waves aur radiowaves sab pehchan aur ilaj mein kaam aati hain. X-rays haddiyon aur andar ke aza ki tasveer ke liye; gamma rays apni zyada penetrating power (andar ghusne ki taqat) ki wajah se nuclear medicine, jaise PET scans, aur cancer ke ilaj mein. Ultrasonic waves ultrasound imaging mein naram tissues dekhne, pet mein bachche ki bimariyon ki nigrani aur aza ke mutale ke liye, ionizing radiation ke baghair mehfooz tareeqe se. Radiowaves MRI jaisi techniques mein atoms ke nuclei se amal kar ke jism ki tafseeli tasveer banati hain, khaas taur par naram tissues ki, nuqsan deh radiation ke baghair.

blocks.prompt: X-rays, ultrasound, gamma rays aur radiowaves ko ionizing aur non-ionizing mein baantein.
blocks.explanation: Ionizing: X-rays aur gamma rays (atoms se electrons nikal sakti hain). Non-ionizing: ultrasound aur radiowaves.

items: Medical physics: physics ke usool pehchan aur ilaj mein (X-ray, ultrasound, CT, PET).
Ionizing radiation (X-rays, gamma rays, positrons) atoms se electrons nikal kar ions banati hai; non-ionizing (ultrasound, radiowaves) nahi.
X-rays: haddiyan; gamma rays: PET aur cancer ka ilaj; ultrasound: naram tissues; radiowaves: MRI.
